name: Camping 101: Skinning

angles.text: Cooking and wilderness survival go hand in hand; as Mendalass notes, setting up a proper campsite requires a basic campfire, a skill traditionally taught by culinary trainers.

faq.answer: Camping 101: Skinning directs skilled skinners to Mendalass Tattermend in Shen'dar Village. By completing this training, adventurers learn how to repurpose harvested hides into a practical Camp Chair for field rest and recuperation.
Mendalass Tattermend is a leatherworking instructor located in Shen'dar Village. He teaches proficient skinners how to stitch harvested hides into comfortable field seating for wilderness camps.

aliases: where do i turn this in
faq.answer: Mendalass Tattermend resides in Shen'dar Village, where adventurers must travel to demonstrate their skill and learn the art of crafting camp gear.
faq.q: Where can Mendalass Tattermend be found?

faq.answer: Skinners learn the pattern to fashion a Camp Chair using the hides and pelts gathered from fallen beasts, providing a comfortable seat to rest upon while out in the wild.
faq.q: What item does this quest teach you to make?

faq.answer: Townsfolk frown upon setting up camp in the middle of settlements. Camps and camp chairs are meant to be pitched out in the wilderness away from city centers.
faq.q: Can you set up camp inside a town?

aliases: what else do i need for camp
faq.answer: Every proper campsite requires a crackling campfire before it is complete. Adventurers who have not yet mastered starting fires are advised to consult a cooking trainer to learn the basics.
faq.q: What else is required to make a proper camp?

sections.body: Harvesting hides from fallen beasts is an essential survival skill across Azeroth, but its utility extends far beyond simple armor crafting. Through Camping 101: Skinning, gatherers learn to direct their trade toward wilderness survival by crafting a portable Camp Chair. Taking time to rest upon a comfortable seat out in the wilds allows weary adventurers to regain their strength and remain in peak fighting condition before their next battle.
sections.title: Comfort in the Wilds

sections.body: To master this pattern, adventurers are sent to Shen'dar Village to meet with Mendalass Tattermend once they have proven their proficiency with a skinning knife. Mendalass instructs travelers on assembling durable seating from collected pelts. However, establishing a campsite requires more than just furniture: settlements will not tolerate impromptu camps within town limits, and no site is truly finished without a crackling campfire, a skill traditionally picked up from local culinary instructors.
sections.title: The Teachings of Shen'dar Village

summary: Camping 101: Skinning instructs adventurers in turning harvested pelts into a functional Camp Chair for field camps. Guided by Mendalass Tattermend in Shen'dar Village, skinners learn to combine their harvesting craft with wilderness survival and campfire relaxation.
